regions.today: Mostly cloudy this evening, with further outbreaks of rain across the south of the province. It will be drier elsewhere with a few sunny spells and some well scattered showers. Moderate west to southwesterly winds will ease this evening.
regions.tonight: Rain will clear from southern areas early tonight, and it will be dry for a time with a fair amount of cloud and a few clear spells. Some patchy outbreaks of rain will develop again later in the night. A few patches of mist and fog will also form. Lowest temperatures of 12 to 15 degrees in light and variable winds.
regions.tomorrow: Tomorrow, Sunday, will be mostly dry with a few bright or sunny spells. Highest temperatures of 18 to 22 degrees, warmest in the southeast, with light variable or southerly winds.
regions.solar_uv: Moderate in sunshine on Sunday. Low on Monday.
